gre_general.value: The Quantitative Biosciences and Engineering PhD does not require the GRE.

supervisor.value: The page says students work with a faculty advisor and interdisciplinary committee, not whether one must agree before admission.

funding.value: Teaching and research assistantships are generally awarded to PhD applicants, according to the university FAQ; the department gives no separate figure.
funding.quote: Both Assistantships are generally awarded to Masters Thesis (MS-T) and Doctoral (PHD) level applicants.

notes: Interdisciplinary PhD spanning biosciences, chemical and mechanical engineering, applied math and computer science. Recorded under biology, with biomedical sciences as an also field.
